data.content_ref: inline:The proposed refutation test is methodologically confused: checking whether the same survival count appears in a mutation set where all entries are exercised by tests would not isolate a registry-size confound—it would test coverage bias, which is a distinct methodological artifact. A registry-size confound concerns how the total number of registered mutations (independent of test coverage) inflates survival rates purely by combinatorial dilution. The correct refutation would require holding test coverage constant while varying registry size, not eliminating coverage variance. As stated, the proposed test conflates two independent sources of bias, making the claimed reduction to registry-size artifact untestable by the specified condition.
